findings.issue: `!commandResult` is mapped to 404 'Order not found', but `false` is also produced when IdentifiedCommandHandler swallows any non-domain exception (DB/concurrency/event-bus failure) via `catch ... return default`. Server faults are now reported as 404 instead of 500.

followUps.title: CreateOrderAsync returns 200 when the create command fails (BUG-9)
followUps.reason: Invalid or failed create-order commands are reported as success to the client; this story left that response unchanged on purpose.
